hebdŏmătĭcus (-mădĭcus ), a, um, adj., = ἑβδοματικός,
I.relating to the number seven: septeni et noveni anni, qui hebdomatici a Graecis atque enneatici appellantur, i. e. critical, decisive of one's fate, Firm. Math. 4, 14 med.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
